sloka: इति इव च अश्रु प्रतिपूर्ण लोचना।समाप्य च स्वस्त्ययनम् यथा विधि ।प्रदक्षिणम् चैव चकार राघवम् ।पुनः पुनः च अपि निपीड्य सस्वजे ॥२-२५-४६॥
transliteration: iti iva ca aśru pratipūrṇa locanā।samāpya ca svastyayanam yathā vidhi ।pradakṣiṇam caiva cakāra rāghavam ।punaḥ punaḥ ca api nipīḍya sasvaje ॥2-25-46॥

translations.english: Thus with her eyes brimming with tears, she duly completed the benedictory rites and circumambulated the scion of the Raghus and embraced him again and again holding him tight.
